doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Touring Japan
summary: Gordon has been to Japan twice with The Orphan Newsboys, where American jazz is adored, but it is very expensive.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I’ve been to Japan twice with The Orphan Newsboys and that is really an experience. If I had — I love to go to Japan because they’re so, they just adore American music over there, so anything American that has to do with jazz, you know you’re already set up as being a hero. And that’s the way we’re thought of over there and it’s a very nice feeling. And the younger generation over there really is in to that kind of music too.
Is the cost of living as expensive as I’ve heard?
It is, it’s very expensive to live over there. One bottle of beer was $10.
